whatsappMessage:
Hi Team Alba beans & coffee,

I noticed your café has strong 4.5★ reviews on Boring Road, but lacked a dedicated mobile page for table reservations and menu exploration.

Maine aapke café ke liye ek custom live website concept design kiya hai — jisme direct WhatsApp table booking, special coffee menu, aur gallery integrate ki hai:

🔗 https://www.arclanestudios.space/sites/albabeans

Aapko overall look aur concept kaisa laga? Would love your honest feedback!

— Ameya Sharma, Arclane Studios
callScript: "Hi Team Alba beans & coffee, Ameya here from Arclane Studios. Maine aapke café ke liye ek custom live website concept banakar WhatsApp par share kiya tha. Bas ek minute check karna tha ki kya aapko link receive hua aur aapne demo glance kiya? We tailored it specifically with direct WhatsApp table booking and mobile-first menu showcase right opposite AN College in Boring Road. Aapko overall look aur concept kaisa laga? Agar aapko concept pasand aaye, to hum isme aapki actual coffee varieties aur contact setup integrate karke live kar sakte hain. Jab bhi aap free hon batayein, we can connect on a quick 5-minute walkthrough."
